brief: Two separate pairs of bases, the pairs joined to each other only with side connectors.

requirements.requirement: Two pairs of bases (four bases total)
requirements.evidence: 4 piece nodes: piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full (pair 1), piece:0,2,0;full, piece:1,2,0;full (pair 2)

requirements.requirement: Pairs are separate (no connector joining the pairs together)
requirements.evidence: Connectors present only within pairs: connector:0#0,0|1,0 and connector:0#0,2|1,2. No connector between y=0 and y=2 rows; gap of one cell row at r=1 separates pairs

requirements.requirement: Pairs joined to each other only with side connectors (no other join type)
requirements.evidence: Each pair joined by side-connector-single; no joint bolts or other connectors used - counts: connector 2, piece 4

finish.summary: Build has 4 bases as two isolated side-by-side pairs, each pair internally linked by one side-connector-single, with a one-cell gap between the pairs and no inter-pair connector.

lines.key: pvc-section-single  (cut 9 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-single (cut 9 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
